closure_reason: Even under a player-favourable assumption that all advertised credit and cash prizes occupy distinct identifiers, at least 449,995 identifiers have no instant prize, far more than the 2,000-entry player cap. Rules allocate identifiers randomly and prohibit choosing a specific number. Thus a legal allocation exists in which all allowed player tickets are residual zero-instant identifiers; the open main draw also retains legal external-winner states.
